components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action on any surface. Indigo gradient with accent glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1, #4f46e5); padding: 14px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(99,102,241,0.35), 0 0 40px rgba(99,102,241,0.1); position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 0%, transparent 50%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #818cf8, #6366f1); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 30px rgba(99,102,241,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(99,102,241,0.35), 0 4px 20px rgba(99,102,241,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: rgba(99,102,241,0.25); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive confirmations only. The only red button.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444, #dc2626); padding: 14px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(239,68,68,0.3); transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 30px rgba(239,68,68,0.35); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(239,68,68,0.3); } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Glass fill, hairline border, indigo glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field__label { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #94a3b8; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 14px 18px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #f8fafc; outline: none; transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #6366f1; background: rgba(99,102,241,0.06); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(99,102,241,0.35); }

components.name: Overlay Card
components.description: The exam surface: glass navy, generous radius, indigo top line.
components.html:
🛡️

CRC Exam Lockdown

This exam is proctored, and you have limited time to complete it.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: rgba(18, 24, 42, 0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.18); border-radius: 24px; padding: 48px 40px 40px; max-width: 480px; width: 92%; text-align: center; backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04), 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.45), 0 0 80px rgba(99,102,241,0.35); font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 20%; right: 20%; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #6366f1, transparent); } .ds-card__icon { width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin: 0 auto 24px; font-size: 32px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(99,102,241,0.2), rgba(99,102,241,0.05)); border: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.25); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(99,102,241,0.35); } .ds-card__title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; color: #f8fafc; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-card__body { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; color: #94a3b8; }

components.name: Warning Toast
components.description: Violation feedback: amber, slides in from the right, passes clicks through.
components.html: ⚠️ Violation 1/4: copy/paste was blocked
components.css: .ds-toast { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.5; color: #ffffff; background: rgba(18, 24, 42, 0.85); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px 22px; max-width: 380px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.3); animation: dsToastIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-toast--warning { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,158,11,0.2), rgba(18,24,42,0.9)); } .ds-toast__msg { font-weight: 600; } @keyframes dsToastIn { from { transform: translateX(40px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; } }

components.name: Timer Chip
components.description: The wall clock: mono time on a status gradient, color-only escalation.
components.css: .ds-timer { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Cascadia Code', monospace; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.3); transition: all 0.5s ease; } .ds-timer--green { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16,185,129,0.85), rgba(5,150,105,0.85)); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(16,185,129,0.25); } .ds-timer--red { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.9), rgba(220,38,38,0.9)); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(239,68,68,0.3); animation: dsTimerPulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes dsTimerPulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.6; } }

components.name: Violation Badge
components.description: The running count, top-left, slate at rest and red at the threshold.
components.css: .ds-badge { font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #ffffff; background: rgba(51,65,85,0.8); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); pointer-events: none; } .ds-badge--warn { background: rgba(245,158,11,0.75); } .ds-badge--danger { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.8); animation: dsBadgePulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes dsBadgePulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.05); } }

narrative.overview: A calm, well-ordered examination room. One proctor at a clean desk, a printed exam paper in front of them, a clock on the wall. Everything a student or invigilator needs is legible at a glance, nothing is decorative that is not functional, and the room never raises its voice. The dark navy surface is the examination hall at night: quiet, serious, and watchful, with the indigo accent as the lamp on the desk and the status colors as the only things allowed to be loud.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy base, indigo accent, status colors that mean something
Glass only on overlays and floating chips, never decorative
Restraint as the default; urgency is earned, not ambient

rules.name: The Only-Loud-Color Rule
rules.body: At rest the surface is navy and indigo. The only saturated colors allowed anywhere are the four status colors, and each one appears only in its meaning.

rules.name: The Glass-Only-on-Overlay Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur appears only on the fullscreen overlay card, floating chips, and the popup.

rules.name: The Timer Rule
rules.body: Time is always mono. The countdown timer is the only place JetBrains Mono appears in the student surface, and it never changes weight, only color.

rules.name: The One-Heading Rule
rules.body: One Title per surface. A card gets one h2, a popup gets one h1.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: No ambient elevation. A surface at rest has no shadow unless it is an overlay card, a floating chip, or a primary action.

dos: Do let status colors carry meaning and nothing else. Green means safe, amber means caution, red means violation. Never use them decoratively.
Do set time in JetBrains Mono. Time is never in Inter.
Do use the indigo glow for focus and primary action.
Do announce violations and system interruptions the way they are: violations in amber or red with the count, system interruptions in neutral with NOT counted.
Do keep the overlay card's top accent line as the only stripe, and only as a top line.
Do keep glass to overlays, floating chips, and the popup.
Do keep every heading count at one per surface.
donts: Don't build surveillance or big-brother aesthetics: no red-alert walls, no blinking guilt, no implied accusation.
Don't use consumer gamified flash: no emoji-heavy playful chrome, no candy gradients, no confetti on a serious exam surface.
Don't ship generic admin grayness: the invigilator's tools carry the same craft as the student's surface, just quieter.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left or border-right thicker than 1px as a colored accent) on cards, toasts, or alerts.
Don't use em dashes in UI copy.
Don't let color be the only signal. Every status has a word next to it.
